70:11.text: Though they shall be made to see one another
[(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]
would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,

70:12.text: And his wife and his brother,

70:13.text: And his kindred who sheltered him,

70:14.text: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.

70:15.text: By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,

70:17.text: such as turn their backs and turn away their faces
[picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up]

70:18.text: (from spending it in the Cause of Allâh)

70:21.text: And niggardly when good touches him.

70:22.text: Except those who are devoted to Salât

70:23.text: Those who remain constant in their Salât

70:24.text: And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right

70:25.text: For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth,
(and his means of living has been straitened)

70:26.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

70:27.text: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

70:28.text: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -

70:29.text: And those who guard their chastity
(i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts)

70:30.text: Except from their wives or the
whom their right hands possess - for

70:31.text: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.

70:32.text: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

70:33.text: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

70:34.text: And those who guard their Salât

70:35.text: Such shall dwell in the Gardens

70:36.text: So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you
[O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)]

70:37.text: in groups on the right and on the left
(of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

70:38.text: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?

70:39.text: No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!
